input: What is the correct notice period for an employee terminated without cause after 3 years?
actual_output:
Legal issue: aviso prévio (notice period) for a dispensa sem justa causa (dismissal without cause) after 3 years of service.

Applicable rule: Lei nº 12.506/2011 sets a proportional notice period — a base of 30 calendar days, plus 3 additional days for each complete year of service beyond the first, capped at a total of 90 days.

Deterministic calculation for exactly 3 complete years of service: 30 + 3 x (3 - 1) = 30 + 6 = 36 calendar days.
